# Exceptions to denylist.txt. One per line: PATH_REGEX:MATCH_REGEX
#   PATH_REGEX   searched in the file's path from the repository root
#   MATCH_REGEX  searched in the matched text. Anchor it with ^ and $
# A hit is dropped when both match. Keep each line as narrow as the reason
# for it, and say the reason in a comment above it.

# The rules themselves, and this file's reasons
^\.github/public-text/(denylist|allowlist|hashed)\.txt$:.

# ticket: standards, encodings and advisory ids, not tickets
.:^(SHA|UTF|RFC|ISO|HTTP|CVE|GO|TLS|AES|ECDSA|RSA|PKCS|X|LICENSE|GPL|BSD|MIT|EC|P|ARM|AMD|ED|IPV|IPv|CP|DES|SHA3|HMAC|ECMA|DNS)-[0-9]+$

# email: noreply, the reserved example and test domains, git remotes
.:^noreply@
.:@(example\.(com|org|net|test|invalid)|[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.(example|test|invalid|localhost))$
.:^git@github\.com$
.:@[A-Za-z0-9-]+\.iam$
.:@users\.noreply\.github\.com$
# email: the address Dependabot signs its commits off with
^commit [0-9a-f]{12}$:^support@github\.com$

# private-ip: documentation CIDRs used anywhere (10.0.x.x, the kube service range)
.:^(10\.0\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+|10\.96\.0\.0)$
# private-ip: generic CIDRs and addresses in examples, tests and the fake
^(examples|docs|templates)/:^(10\.0\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+|10\.[0-9]+\.0\.0|172\.16\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+|192\.168\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+)$
_test\.go$:^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$
^internal/tools/fakeapi/:^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$

# home-path: the placeholder user
.:^/Users/you$

# ai-tool: the API's pagination field, not the editor
^internal/provider/(cluster_events|datasource_webhook_deliveries)\.go$:^Cursor$
^internal/tools/fakeapi/pager\.go$:^Cursor$
^internal/k0rdent/(spec/openapi\.yaml|types\.gen\.go|client\.gen\.go)$:^Cursor$
# ai-trailer: "generated with the request builders", copied client prose
^internal/k0rdent/error\.go$:^generated with$

# staging: a generic environment name in an example's validation message
^examples/walkthrough/full/variables\.tf$:^staging$
# staging: the cp-staging project name in the list-resource example
^(docs/list-resources/kubernetes_cluster\.md|examples/list-resources/k0rdent_kubernetes_cluster/):^staging$

# gh-login: the maintainers, in CODEOWNERS only
^\.github/CODEOWNERS$:^(jeremypruitt|retrospct)$

# The pre-release provider address a migrating state may still name
^docs/public-compatibility\.md$:^retrospct$

# A test that bans the word from guidance text has to spell it
^internal/provider/error_guidance_internal_test\.go$:^customer$

# The API's own descriptions, copied unchanged so the client matches its spec
^internal/k0rdent/(spec/openapi\.yaml|[a-z]+\.gen\.go)$:^([Cc]ustomers?|partner|MVP|NVIDIA)$
^internal/k0rdent/(spec/openapi\.yaml|[a-z]+\.gen\.go)$:^(10\.[0-9.]+|172\.(1[6-9]|2[0-9]|3[01])\.[0-9.]+|192\.168\.[0-9.]+)$
^internal/k0rdent/spec/openapi\.yaml$:^(ops@vendor\.example\.com|k0smotron@db\.example\.internal)$

# machine-type: the API's GPU platform enum, copied unchanged from its spec
^internal/k0rdent/(spec/openapi\.yaml|[a-z]+\.gen\.go)$:^GB300$
